Reference Translation (provided): Midway upon the road of our life I found myself within a dark wood, for the right way had been missed.

**(a) Interpretation Lock – ONE BULLET PER SOURCE LINE**
- **Line 1 – “Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita”** → *Locked Meaning*: There exists a journey (*cammin*) that belongs to “our life” (*nostra vita*). The speaker is positioned at the exact middle point (*mezzo*) of that journey, i.e., *mid‑way* along the road of our life. - **Line 2 – “mi ritrovai per una selva oscura,”** → *Locked Meaning*: The first‑person subject (*I*) finds (or discovers) himself (*mi*) located *within* (*per*) a singular, dark forest (*una selva oscura*). - **Line 3 – “ché la diritta via era smarrita.”** → *Locked Meaning*: Because (*ché*) the definite, straight/right path (*la diritta via*) was in a state of being lost (*era smarrita*), i.e., the correct way had been missed.
*(No comparative or degree expressions are present, so no A > B or degree specifications are required.)*
